header: One working day, seen from four roles
subheadline: Evaluations often stall when the dispatcher likes the system and finance sees no benefit. Here is what each role gets on a normal Tuesday.

items.title: One board instead of six phone calls
items.description: Sick calls, breakdowns and a broken-down van appear on one screen. One drag reassigns a job and updates the technician's phone within two seconds.

items.title: Everything for the job on the phone
items.description: Route, job sheets, asset history and site access notes are on the phone before the first drive. They stay available for seven days without signal.

items.title: Contracts priced on real figures
items.description: Hours, travel and parts add up per service contract. Loss-making sites show up in month two, not at renewal.

items.title: Invoices leave the same week
items.description: Signed job sheets go to DATEV, BMD or Sage 50 on your schedule, with parts and labour split by cost centre.
